title: Immigration Consultant Dubai | Digital Visa File Prep — SK Immigration
description: SK Immigration serves UAE residents digitally — study visas, visit files, attestation and company documentation. Meet in Dubai by appointment. Written fees. No visa guarantees.

faqs.question: Do you have an office in Dubai?
faqs.answer: Yes. SK Immigration is digital-first and also meets clients in Dubai by appointment. WhatsApp +92 304 5999859 for the current meeting point and a written scope. We do not publish a walk-in street address that might go stale.

faqs.question: I live in Dubai — can you still prepare my Germany or UK study file?
faqs.answer: Yes. Residence in the UAE does not block a study-visa file. We work from your passport, academics, funds trail and the destination mission’s current rules. You share documents online; a Dubai meeting is optional.

faqs.question: Are you a UAE-licensed recruitment agency?
faqs.answer: No. We prepare documentation and guidance. We do not sell jobs in the UAE or claim MOHRE/Tasheel recruitment licensing. Employers and authorities decide work outcomes.

faqs.question: What languages and hours do you use with UAE clients?
faqs.answer: English and Urdu, WhatsApp-first, aligned to your timezone. Head-office hours are Monday–Saturday 10:00–19:00 Pakistan time; Dubai appointments are booked around that.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee a UAE or Schengen visa?
faqs.answer: No. GDRFA, embassies and universities decide. We prepare complete, honest files and separate our fee from government charges.

body:
SK Immigration is a digital immigration desk that also meets clients in Dubai by appointment. The product is the same as Pakistan: written scope, embassy-sourced checklists, and no visa guarantees — whether you are in Business Bay or on a night shift in Abu Dhabi.

Who this page is for

UAE residents and visitors searching for an immigration consultant in Dubai who will not trap them in a shopfront sales pitch. Typical files: Europe/UK/Canada study from the UAE, visit visas, document attestation (including Musadaqa-related chains), and international company-registration paperwork.

Digital first — office second

Most UAE clients never need a room. You send passport biodata, academics, bank evidence and a goal. We return a pathway note and a written fee. If you want a face-to-face review of originals, we schedule a Dubai appointment. That meeting does not change who decides the visa: the destination authority does.

  • WhatsApp file sharing and status updates
  • Same checklists we publish on country landers
  • Optional Dubai appointment for original-document review
  • No “inside track” at GDRFA, VFS or embassies

What we prepare from the UAE

  • Study-visa files for Germany, UK, Canada, Italy and other destinations you already qualify for
  • Visit/tourist files where your ties and funds are real
  • Attestation sequencing when a Gulf or European receiver actually needs it
  • Company-registration documentation (this is not a UAE visa or Golden Visa product)

What we do not do in the UAE

  • Sell jobs, visit-to-work conversions, or “guaranteed” labour cards
  • Claim MOHRE, Tasheel or PRO licensing we do not hold
  • Invent hotel/airline visit sponsorships

How a Dubai client starts

  1. Send a short profile on WhatsApp or the assessment form
  2. Receive a written scope — service fee vs government/VFS fees
  3. Upload documents; we flag gaps against official pages
  4. Optional appointment in Dubai to check originals
  5. You submit through the official portal or centre. Authorities decide.
